headline: Guard note for rich/segment.py edits
what_breaks: rich/console.py — relies on Segment for rendering text
rich/text.py — uses Segment for styled text representation
rich/jupyter.py — depends on Segment for output formatting
why: The Segment class is integral to text rendering across multiple modules. Changes here could disrupt how text is displayed in the console and other components.
checklist: Review changes to Segment class and its properties
Check interactions with cell_len and get_character_cell_size functions
Ensure backward compatibility with Console and other importers
Verify that control codes are handled correctly in Segment
